<DOCSTRING>
Summary: Represents the state labels of a board from a player's point of view.

Description: This class defines the state labels used in a board game from the perspective of a player. It is instantiated to provide a consistent set of labels for different board states, which are then used by various game components to interpret the board.

Attributes:
    missed (str): Represents the label for a missed shot. Set to "M" during initialization.
    hit (str): Represents the label for a hit shot. Set to "H" during initialization.
    ship (str): Represents the label for a ship presence. Set to "S" during initialization.
    unoccupied (str): Represents the label for an unoccupied cell. Set to "-" during initialization.
</DOCSTRING>
